basics.name: Maya Schneider
basics.title: Senior Product Manager
basics.summary: Product manager with 8+ years shipping B2B SaaS in Swiss and European tech. I turn messy customer problems into focused roadmaps, run tight discovery-to-delivery loops, and pair qualitative research with hard data to make bets I can defend. Fluent in German and English, comfortable owning a product area end to end.

highlights: Own the spend-management platform (cards + invoices), a €4M+ ARR product area serving 500+ mid-market customers across DACH.
Led discovery and launch of an AI invoice-capture flow that cut manual entry time by 62% and became the top driver of new-logo conversion.
Rebuilt the quarterly roadmap process around opportunity-solution trees, lifting on-time delivery from 55% to 88% across three squads.
Partnered with sales and CS to define a usage-based expansion motion that grew net revenue retention from 104% to 121%.
Managed the developer SDK for smart data capture used by 20k+ developers, owning API design and the pricing/packaging redesign.
Ran a continuous interview cadence (5 users/week) that reshaped the onboarding flow and cut time-to-first-scan from 3 days to under 2 hours.
Shipped the self-serve trial funnel, adding CHF 1.8M in self-serve pipeline in its first year.
Owned checkout and payments for Switzerland's largest online retailer, running A/B tests that lifted checkout conversion 9%.
Coordinated a cross-functional squad of 6 engineers and 1 designer through a full basket redesign.

skillCategories.value: Continuous interviewing, JTBD, opportunity-solution trees, usability testing
SQL, Amplitude, Mixpanel, A/B testing, funnel analysis

tailoredMetadata.jobDescriptionSnapshot: Swiss Re is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our internal Data Platform. You will define the product vision for self-serve data access, partner with data engineering and actuarial teams, and drive adoption of governed data products across the organization. We are looking for someone with strong stakeholder management, a data-driven approach to prioritization, experience with B2B or internal enterprise platforms, and the ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into clear roadmaps. Experience with SQL, analytics tooling, API/platform product management, and OKRs is expected. German is a plus.

sectionChanges.note: Reframed the summary around enterprise/data-platform product management and stakeholder alignment to mirror the job description.
Surfaced platform, API, and governed-data-access highlights and moved the SDK/platform work up; quantified metrics preserved verbatim.
Promoted 'Data-Driven Decision Making' and 'Stakeholder Management' to the top to match the role's emphasis.
Kept SQL, Amplitude, and OKRs prominent; no new skills invented.
